novelty_flags.one_line: This is Tamano's published front-door example in different variable names: the same covariance functional, flag denominator Δ1Δ2, c=10, and denominator pivot already appear in equations (23)–(24).

source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 1, lines 192–213; Theorem 3(iii) and Remark 4, lines 255–278; equations (23)–(24), lines 417–425
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that the dimension-three mixed family remains open, gives the flag-power Wishart pivot, and explicitly gives the front-door covariance functional with denominator σXX(σXXσMM−σXM²), self-normalization constant 10, and samplewise n/10 pivot.

The half-trek criterion is a graphical sufficient condition for generic identifiability in linear structural equation models and supports the proposal's use of rational graph-derived certificates as an application family.

The article describes transitive cone automorphisms and Vinberg/Siegel recursive constructions of homogeneous cones; it does not state an all-dimensional converse for self-normalizing covariance polynomials.
